title: A research run
description: research/<id>/run.json. Every run is stored the same way; scripts/check.py enforces this and schema/RUNS.md says which files each kind of run keeps.

id.description: the folder name: <YYYY-MM-DD>-<n>-<slug>, n counting runs on that day

kind.description: manual: written from records by hand; agents: single read-only agents with free-text reports; sweep: the learnings-sweep workflow; merge: the learnings-merge workflow on its own

status.description: planned (folder made), running, recorded (outputs stored), assimilated (merged into learnings/)

workflow.description: the workflow script used, as run

transcript.description: the run's transcript folder, with home as ~

agents.description: the agent type and what each was asked

verified_by.description: how candidates were checked before being kept

sources.description: keys of sources/sources.json the run read
